reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; the bar lines are read off the rhythm (CCEH's Noteworthy score could not be read); check the pickup against the score. Imported from CCEH tune 000523 (the melody read from 000523a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 13); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. William Batchelder Bradbury's dates (1816–1868) are from our page for the tune BRADBURY (content/hymns/tunes/bradbury.json); CCEH's page gives none. The tune ends on D, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
